notes: Created initial story set for Provider Detail Lookup with full coverage.

EVAL-F-002-S1.title: Define Provider Detail Schema and Contract
EVAL-F-002-S1.description: Define the response schema for provider detail including NPI credentials, demographics, and structured external research links (NPI, Healthgrades, state boards).

EVAL-F-002-S2.title: Implement NPI Registry Lookup Logic
EVAL-F-002-S2.description: Implement core service logic to query CMS NPI Registry API, parse provider credentials, and normalize fields for downstream use.

EVAL-F-002-S3.title: Generate External Research Links
EVAL-F-002-S3.description: Construct standardized external research URLs including NPI profile, Healthgrades, and supported state medical boards (DE, MS, VA).

EVAL-F-002-S4.title: Expose Provider Detail via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-F-002-S4.description: Integrate provider detail lookup into evaluate_care_facade and expose as a callable tool endpoint for the chat system.

EVAL-F-002-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Detail Lookup
EVAL-F-002-S5.description: Create tests covering NPI lookup, credential parsing, link generation, and end-to-end facade integration.
